rank_models.repeatable: No arbitrary skill-rank cap; rising cost; do not sell ranks above native/effective engine maximum.
rank_models.bounded: Finite useful investment; stop at observed effective mechanical limit and no paid overflow.
rank_models.once: Single permanent unlock; no meaningless repeated purchases.
rank_models.staged: Finite meaningful states; cap dynamically at the actual final pack tool/ability stages.

skills.description: Permits valid drops at progressively higher real tool tiers; no extra ranks after the highest legitimate pack tier.
skills.notes: Must respect required tool category, non-vanilla tiers, protected ores and real drop logic.

skills.name: Barehand Mining Speed
skills.description: Increasing hand-breaking speed, escalating rank costs, no arbitrary rank cap. Never improves harvest tier.
skills.notes: One upgrade orchestrates source attributes to avoid compounding one purchase.

skills.name: Glass Touch
skills.description: Harvest ordinary glass like Silk Touch when using compliant empty hands; original Monk registered extra.

skills.name: Delicate Hands
skills.description: Wider Silk Touch analogue for valid hand-harvestable blocks, independent from Glass Touch.

skills.name: Fortunate Hands
skills.description: Fortune-like drop bonus up to the actually achievable equipment enchantment bound, respecting recipes.

skills.name: Looting Palm
skills.description: Looting-like bonus from qualifying unarmed or personally credited spells.

skills.name: Gentle Shearing
skills.description: Legal empty-hand shearing/plant gathering without carrying shears.

skills.name: Spirit Projectile
skills.description: Legal Monk ranged attack for combat and boss crystal interactions; other projectile upgrades apply.

skills.name: Guarding Palm
skills.description: Innate defensive counter/reflect capability without conventional shield.

skills.name: Boss Shield Contact
skills.description: Ensure a legal ranged/unarmed Monk attack can interact with Draconic Guardian shields and crystals by normal boss rules.
skills.notes: Compatibility fix, not a bypass or bonus damage; only expose as skill if normal spells fail.

skills.name: Withering Stare
skills.description: Sustained gaze damages/Withers eligible targets; preserve original Monk's distinctive stare.

skills.name: Catch Arrows
skills.description: Intercept and optionally recover arrows while unarmed; must define projectile eligibility.

skills.name: Creeper Kiss
skills.description: Pacify or harmlessly greet a creeper while empty-handed.

skills.name: Animal Friendship
skills.description: Tame/friendly interactions with animals while empty-handed; never trivialize rare boss mobs.

skills.name: Hunger Discipline
skills.description: Reduce food exhaustion while keeping consumption and unique-food discovery meaningful.

skills.name: Purifying Meditation
skills.description: Active bounded cooldown cleanse of harmful potion effects; not global permanent immunity.

skills.name: Fire Resilience
skills.description: Passive mitigation of fire damage independent from native burning duration.

skills.name: Lava Survival
skills.description: Special brief protection when in lava; not unconditional hazard immunity.

skills.name: Explosion Resilience
skills.description: Incoming explosion damage mitigation; different from blast knockback resistance.

skills.name: Water Walking
skills.description: Walk on water surface without boots or permanent potion.

skills.name: Breath Meditation
skills.description: Two meaningful stages: slower air depletion then full underwater breathing.
skills.notes: max_ranks fixed 2; staged method differs from harvest tier.

skills.name: Blink
skills.description: Short-distance safe teleportation with reliable collision, cooldown, line of sight.

skills.name: Momentum Gliding
skills.description: Post-Ender Dragon innate non-hovering glide acceleration; does NOT grant Creative Flight.
skills.notes: Progression condition already owner-locked: Ender Dragon. Do not duplicate Draconic Curio ability.

skills.name: Monastic Mastery Learning
skills.description: Improves earned Monk Mastery XP with escalating costs and anti-exploit checks; distinct from vanilla XP.

skills.name: Focused Advancement
skills.description: Additional skill points per completed Monk faction rank, within supported Vampirism accounting; no duplication exploits.

notes: All effects remain conceptual; skills must not be represented as playable yet.
Repeatable means no arbitrary skill rank cap but any native engine max still applies. A numerical trait with no further effect must not accept a paid upgrade.
Distinct mod energy resources and mana pools retain separate skill IDs.
No wearable armor or conventional weapon is a prerequisite.
All numerical skills are conditional on actual player-attached attribute and meaningful effect test. Non-attached/mob-only candidates are deliberately excluded.
The backend and progression placement are intentionally undecided.
